appraisal.studyDesign: Random-effects meta-analysis of longitudinal predictors of suicidal thoughts and behaviors across 365 studies, 3,428 effect sizes, and 50 years.
appraisal.population: Participants in longitudinal studies predicting later suicidal ideation, attempt, or death; pooled demographic composition was not reported in the abstract.
appraisal.comparator: Risk-factor categories and exposure levels versus later specific suicidal-thought-or-behavior outcomes; no treatment comparator.
appraisal.outcomes: Prediction was only slightly better than chance across odds-ratio, hazard-ratio, and diagnostic-accuracy analyses; no broad category predicted far above chance and accuracy did not improve over 50 years.
